hypothesis: The scored log SF is an observed difference whose read endpoint carries its own reading error; predicting the observable (latent curve + posterior mean of the read metal's noise) instead of the latent curve lowers the error on pairs with one read endpoint and raises pooled R2 over RIDGE2.
contract: k-shot metal model, k+1 metals read by gen20's DOPT_Q (label-free); uses only the support differences to the first read metal (as gen20); fold prior / lambda / s2 / G14 covariance from the outer training fold (gen20 selection); @RESEL re-chooses (noise factor, lambda) on the 4-fold inner cross-fit of the training fold by pooled squared error at k = 1..3. Zero-shot (k = 0) is identical to RIDGE2's prior.
